title: Model selection is a task experiment, not a brand preference
text: Acharya’s discussion calls for practical familiarity with different models and connects selection to the task’s upside and verifiability. A useful application is to compare configurations on the same accepted-work definition rather than presume the cheapest or most capable model is always the economical choice.
qualification: Investor/practitioner opinion in supplied summary. Model-specific capability and cost claims are not treated as current facts.
